name: Paper strip collage cuts
what: A torn paper strip with one line of text lies on a tabletop that cuts to a new surface every 7 frames - paper, linen, stone, kraft, cutting mats, plaster, wood - while the strip stays; it changes colour (red, cream, wine) and size a little at each cut, and grows and tilts a touch more as it goes.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f195: a hard cut of the surface every 7 f (f7, f14 ... f189; 28 pictures); at each cut the strip changes colour and size a little; inside a cut the surface and the strip push in linearly (+0.65 % scale, -0.18 deg, about 5 px drift in 6 f); over the whole clip the strip grows (583 to 737 px of the 720-px original) and tilts (0 to -5.5 deg)

tracks.name: surface cuts
tracks.what: the tabletop cuts to a new surface (14 different ones, cycled twice)

tracks.what: the strip changes colour (red, cream, wine) and size a little at each cut

tracks.name: grow and tilt
